ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and other cases of tax fraud and mismanagement.
questions: What is the extent of fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale problem with fraud in Minnesota, and could lead to further investigations and reforms.
